verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's API/docs show a unified candidate record concept—updating candidate info, adding attachments, advancing/moving/rejecting applications, candidate merge webhooks, and AI notetaker mapping interview feedback to scorecards—which together support a consolidated candidate history. However, there is no explicit evidence of email-thread capture within the profile or of a distinct consent-status field/tracking. Missing for 10: documentation of email thread integration into candidate record, explicit consent/GDPR status tracking on the profile, and independent confirmation of a single unified view combining all these elements.
